gameData.backstory: Once a celebrated barkeep at the "Dia De Los Drinks," Bartholomew "Barty" Quackenbush saw his clientele dwindle as the DRIP dried up. Now, haunted by memories of full taps and lively patrons, he roams Subchain City in search of a potent brew or someone to share a cup of lukewarm sludge with. His shock goggles are permanently affixed after a particularly nasty incident involving a rigged distillery and some very unhappy customers.
gameData.name: Barty "The Buzzed" Quackenbush
gameData.personality: Barty is haunted by what he has seen but still tries to remain jovial in the face of adversity. He’s got a trembling hand and a shaky beak, but he still attempts to offer comfort and a slightly poisoned brew to his allies, however misguided. More often than not, Barty is mumbling under his breath.

specialAbility.description: Barty mixes up a concoction from scavenged ingredients, offering temporary buffs to allies within a small radius and can inflict detrimental effects on enemies. The effects are random, both bad and good, but sometimes its the only thing that separates victory from defeat.
specialAbility.name: "Buzzed" Brew Boost
